label: daily-unwrap-ungrouped-sum-aligned
description: An ungrouped sum over rate or sum_over_time with unwrap (PR for semantics/unwrap-rate-ungrouped-sum-per-stream): Loki answers one series; a sliding window ([5m] over a smaller step) answered one series per stream and parsed label set, from per-stream stats or raw rows. U1-U4 are sliding range queries over logfmt and JSON streams (U4 broad: every production stream), U5-U7 are instant queries (U6 the `| json` route that read raw rows), U8 is the grouped form that was already one series per group (it must not move), U9 folds a function taken per series. Run with the control set.
